text:
anya: quick async — ran the warmup experiment for kernel v2.3 on dedicated GPU pool A. Steps: prefetch enabled, batch_size=32, kv_cache warmup=2000 tokens. saw initial P90 drop from 150ms -> 130ms :tada:

miguel: nice. which model and quantization? cpu/gpu profile?

anya: running gp2-small (gptx-6b q4_0) on A100s; quantization applied. bench-bot posted full run below.

bench-bot: ```
bench summary
model: gptx-6b q4_0
warmup tokens: 2k
p50: 42ms
p90: 128ms
p99: 320ms
throughput: 520 toks/s
kv-hit-rate: 88%
evictions/min: 0.3
```

samir: kv-hit-rate 88% good. was that with prefetch sweep enabled? any cold-request outliers?

anya: prefetch sweep on. saw a cluster of cold tails (~10 req) hitting 800ms due to cache miss + recompile; tracking in #incidents for now. Added an extra `--prefetch-threshold=0.1` tweak that removed most.

miguel: can you drop the small PR link? want to review perf tweak and the flag.

anya: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/987 — it's tiny. main change: only trigger prefetch on tokens > 64 and don't prefetch for short chats.

rachael: small nit in PR, but LGTM. can we add a unit that simulates <64 tokens to avoid regressions? :eyes:

samir: also, can we add a canary route in ded cluster with fallback to v2.2 if latency >200ms for 5min? ops is fine to add.

anya: noted. will add canary config and backstop. scheduling rollout tomorrow at 09:30 PT. ping @miguel for canary approval.

miguel: approved. I'll watch metrics during rollout. :thumbsup:

bench-bot: recorded rollout plan and baseline in perf dashboard: https://perf.redwood.ai/runs/2171112223

anya: thanks all — no blockers besides the incident log. will follow up with short blurb in eng-email after rollout.
